description: Named for the planet that houses a monastery dedicated to Kahless the Unforgettable, the I.K.S. Boreth is House Sov’s first original starship. Leaning heavily on established Imperial designs, the I.K.S. Boreth is a powerful Battleship that features adaptive shielding and avant-garde weapons systems - a true showcase of House Sov’s ability to innovate and adapt.

ship_ability.title: Through the Veil
ship_ability.description: Increases Isolytic Damage by +{value} vs all oponents in the Veil (does not apply to Stations).
